No one is safe from the potential consequences of the AI race. So why aren’t companies like OpenAI and Anthropic slowing their roll? Vox’s Sigal Samuel explains why the best thing for companies to do is…stop — and how you can get involved in pushing back against AI: https://www.vox.com/future-perfect/507875/anthropic-ipo-stop-ai-race-safety
